items.question: What is Appstle® Inc?
items.answer: Appstle is a B2B SaaS company specializing in the e-commerce sector. Founded by a former Apple-Siri engineer, and a former BCG consultant and an ex-Amazonian, Appstle leverages cutting-edge technology to develop innovative, customizable, and cost-effective applications, aimed to help e-commerce brands with customer retention.Appstle’s solutions empower online retailers to deliver a seamless and exceptional end-to-end experience for their customers.

Appstle is a B2B SaaS company specializing in the e-commerce sector. Founded by a former Apple-Siri engineer, and a former BCG consultant and an ex-Amazonian, Appstle leverages cutting-edge technology to develop innovative, customizable, and cost-effective applications, aimed to help e-commerce brands with customer retention.

Appstle’s solutions empower online retailers to deliver a seamless and exceptional end-to-end experience for their customers.

items.question: Where is Appstle® Inc based?
items.answer: Appstle® Inc. is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Appstle also has business offices in Vancouver, British Columbia, and South Asia.

items.question: What are Appstle’s Key Pillars and Product Focus?
items.answer: Appstle offers advanced solutions designed to enhance customer loyalty, retention, and customer wallet share in the e-commerce space. Our flagship product, Appstle Subscriptions—along with Appstle Memberships, Appstle Loyalty, and Appstle Bundles—empowers merchants to build lasting customer relationships through automated recurring orders, exclusive membership offerings, personalized rewards programs, and dynamic product bundling. These tools help e-commerce businesses drive key growth metrics such as Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), supporting long-term success.

items.question: What is a subscription, and how does it work with Appstle?
items.answer: “Subscriptions”, is a business or revenue model, in which products or services are sold on an automated, recurring basis, instead of as a one-time transaction. It allows your customers to automatically and without any friction, receive and pay for products on a recurring basis. Appstle makes it easy to set up and manage flexible subscription plans on your Shopify or Shopify Plus store.

items.answer: Appstle helps increase customer retention and customer lifetime value (CLTV) by not only enabling recurring revenue, but also making the end-to-end merchant and shopper journey smooth and seamless. items.question: What is a loyalty program?
items.answer: Loyalty programs are one of the most popular customer retention strategies, used to incentivize customers to stick with a particular store or brand. This is done by offering them benefits (e.g. loyalty points) for purchasing products from a store, or sometimes even visiting a store, that can be redeemed for things like a free product, store credits, discount, etc. There are plenty different types of costumer loyalty programs, click here to learn more.A loyalty program is ideal for stores or brands that have a considerable amount of competition (i.e. similar products and services). By offering loyalty programs, businesses can turn their customers’ attention to their brand, and sustain it for a long time. Here are 20 shopify loyalty program examples and insights.

items.answer: Activity rules are a set of rules or guidelines set by the merchant for customers to follow, in order for the customers to earn loyalty points.

items.question: What are reward rules?
items.answer: While activity rules determine what actions the customers should do to gain points, reward rules determine the ways in which the customers are allowed to spend it. Setting attractive rewards are essential to make the customer feel valued, and to sustain their interest and loyalty for a long period of time.
